rationale: THIS REPOSITORY'S declaration — EOS's own, not a blank template line. EOS's product IS its engine: .github/eos/ is a zero-dependency Node program with a real test suite, so EOS runs its own product-quality gate against its own code. IF YOU COPIED THIS TEMPLATE, this file describes EOS, not your project, and "templateDefault": true says so: run `node .github/eos/eos.mjs init` to see the governance tracks and starter packs, then `node .github/eos/eos.mjs init <pack> [--track standard|regulated] --write` to replace it with yours. Until you do, `eos next` asks for exactly that. "workflowProfile" selects the gate policy in .eos/workflow.json; "complianceProfile": "regulated" puts the project on the Regulated track (docs/compliance-profile.json stays authoritative for which regime applies).
